adoption: Even a statistical/cost threshold match only nominates a candidate for subsequent production and authorized-business-data qualification
artifact_bytes_scope: Measured direct export (model context/config/weights or skops) only; excludes MLflow envelope, operational upload metadata and the product signed license.json notice added outside this frozen direct-model benchmark.

cgroup_envelope_observed.interpretation: Shared quota across this workspace processes, not four dedicated physical cores. Co-tenant builds/tests ran during part of development; logical CPU count is not the quota.

cold_warm_scope: First model call and object eviction/reload in disposable Python processes; OS page caches are not purged. Two timing repetitions per request size do not qualify API p95/p99 or disk-cold startup.
cost_uncertainty: Cost thresholds use measured point estimates plus a declared workload projection; two warm timing repetitions do not establish confidence intervals for cost ratios, and shared-host timing may vary.
deployment_environment: Shared cloud CPU quota; co-tenant workload uncontrolled; no interactive SLA qualified
excluded_profile: Uncached regression remains not qualified even if an isolated rerun succeeds; v2 does not execute its nine development cases.
includes: local skops or declarative TabICL JSON+safetensors export

independent_product_admission.classification: Experimental manual pilot only; no automatic promotion or global activation.
independent_product_admission.regression: All TabICL regression profiles are refused by product services/UI after cached-profile parity failure in development; any per-task statistical/cost eligibility below cannot override this restriction.

not_measured: additional classification predict_proba forward in production
scope: Offline direct-model lifecycle; technical qualification only
stopped_prequalification: Earlier interrupted v1 campaigns remain diagnostic evidence. Their final reserve was never opened. Their 4471.139346-second conservative charge plus a 3600-second P5 diagnostic reserve are carried into v2; neither reserve is a new model measurement.
storage: Disposable local benchmark artifacts do not add an experiment store; production stays on existing ObjectStore/MinIO and MLflow
uncertainty_scope: Paired IID 95% percentile intervals are per task, not simultaneous family-wise guarantees across six tasks. Repeated development splits overlap and are used for selection only; no uncertainty estimate treats them as independent samples.
